parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the button of a pen, typically made of plastic, located at the top end of the pen.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to extend or retract the pen tip by pressing it, controlling the writing mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main cylindrical body of the pen, made of plastic, which houses the ink cartridge and provides grip for writing.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the structural support of the pen, containing the ink refill and providing a surface for the user to hold.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the main handle of the pen.
